scope: Substantive claims in the title, abstract, introduction, results, discussion, and conclusion, checked against immutable research artifacts.

entries.claim: The system advises native PostgreSQL extended statistics for a workload and evaluates recommendations through a catalogless hypothetical planner mechanism.
entries.scope: The mechanism and effectiveness claims are bounded by the registered PostgreSQL build, datasets, workloads, truth contracts, and fixture forms.
entries.correction: Do not imply a replacement cardinality estimator, PostgreSQL upstream support, or arbitrary-query fidelity.

entries.claim: Recommendations improve cardinality-estimation quality on the declared workloads and generalize to held-out queries from the same workload-generation contract.
entries.scope: RQ1a is in-workload; RQ1b is same-generator held-out evaluation; strict-unseen is a secondary exact-query diagnostic.
entries.correction: Do not call RQ1b arbitrary distribution-shift robustness or treat historical S_test as an oracle.

entries.claim: Sample-selected recommendations can retain utility after independent full-data native-statistics realization, but sample-side improvement does not guarantee full-data improvement.
entries.scope: Four dataset-scoped P0/P1/P2 comparisons and descriptive sample/full relationships; one native full-data realization per child.
entries.correction: Do not claim guaranteed transfer, causal separation from native ANALYZE variability, or a universal sample/full correlation.

entries.claim: Catalogless hypothetical evaluation matches the registered physical mechanism fixtures under the declared controls.
entries.scope: Primary 9/9 same-patched-binary comparisons and secondary 9/9 physical sanity comparisons on registered synthetic fixtures.
entries.correction: Do not generalize the 9/9 result to arbitrary SQL, datasets, statistic kinds, or PostgreSQL versions.

entries.claim: Greedy ADD is useful in the tested fixed-k comparisons but is not universally superior or globally optimal.
entries.scope: Greedy wins the tested Forest10, Power7, and DMV11 comparisons; Singleton wins Census13. Census13 and DMV11 Greedy outcomes are budget-censored, and Forest10 uses historical v1 timing.
entries.correction: The 300-second limit is a Greedy/K_s search-stage deadline, not an equal end-to-end cost budget; the cancelled 2,000-evaluation study has no results.

entries.claim: With fixed membership and payloads, changing hypothetical activation order can change cardinality estimates, and the Advisor reference order is favorable among the seven declared treatments.
entries.scope: Controlled hypothetical patched-PostgreSQL contract across four datasets; physical non-reference observations are operational and confounded by payload and ordinary-statistics drift.
entries.correction: Do not claim global ordering optimality, runtime improvement, or a universal PostgreSQL OID-precedence rule.

entries.claim: The five-realization Native ANALYZE observations show qualified descriptive stability patterns, including no recorded first-place winner reversal within the three dataset strata.
entries.scope: Post-hoc reanalysis of a v1 campaign that remains failed/ineligible; Forest10 is historical-v1, Census13/DMV11 are v2 strata, and six dependency payloads are native-null-supported rather than directly SQL-NULL verified.
entries.correction: Do not present this as prospective confirmatory evidence, deterministic ANALYZE, or universal ranking robustness.

entries.claim: The measured operational stages establish a qualified practicality account.
entries.scope: Snapshot, deployment, native ANALYZE, profiling, search, planning, and external-label import stages are measured or derived from validated traces; production-exact truth timing, refresh quality trends, and canonical end-to-end cost remain unmeasured.
entries.correction: Do not equate absent learned-model inference with zero production overhead or claim production readiness.

unsupported_claims: global optimality of membership or ordering
end-to-end resource-normalized superiority of Greedy ADD
deterministic or universally stable native ANALYZE
full production cost validation or production readiness
review_boundary: No new PostgreSQL, Advisor, ANALYZE, EXPLAIN, COUNT, or workload execution was performed.
